prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Consider this Verilog module \"full_module\":","S02":"// module full_module (","S03":"//     input [2:0] r,","S04":"//     input L,","S05":"//     input clk,","S06":"//     output reg [2:0] q","S07":");","S08":"// always @(posedge clk) begin","S09":"//     if (L) begin","S10":"//         q <= r;","S11":"//     end else begin","S12":"//         q <= {q[1] ^ q[2], q[0], q[2]};","S13":"//     end","S14":"// end","S15":"// endmodule","S16":"// You want to create a hierarchical Verilog design where a flipflop and 2-1 multiplexer are in a submodule, and that submodule is instantiated three times in this code.","S17":"Create the submodule called \"top_module\"."}

{"ports":{"inputs":{"L":1,"q_in":1,"r_in":1},"outputs":{"Q":1},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"Q","meaning":"1-bit registered output state updated on posedge clk","update_time":"posedge clk after input setup","update_during_reset":false}],"rules":[{"id":"load_r","outputs":["Q"],"condition":"L == 1","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"if (L) begin","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"L":1,"q_in":0,"r_in":1},{"L":1,"q_in":1,"r_in":0},{"L":1,"q_in":1,"r_in":1}],"expected":[{"Q":1},{"Q":0},{"Q":1}]}},{"id":"hold_q_in","outputs":["Q"],"condition":"L == 0","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"2-1 multiplexer","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"L":0,"q_in":0,"r_in":1},{"L":0,"q_in":1,"r_in":0},{"L":0,"q_in":0,"r_in":0}],"expected":[{"Q":0},{"Q":1},{"Q":0}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"none","name":null,"active":"none","values":{"Q":null},"first_released_cycle":"not_applicable"},"mid":"Optional mid input changes occur after the posedge sample and are carried to the next row; they do not affect the already sampled Q.","uncertain":[]}
